oneLineRole: The docs-folder index: a one-page map routing the reader to every other doc by what they want to understand (why/what, build status, invariants, per-act plans, decisions, research numbers, glossary, insights).

items.claim: This folder (docs/) is the project's documentation. For the project overview — what The Back Nine is, how it works, and where the build stands — the reader starts at the repo-root README at ../README.md. The docs/README.md page itself is purely the map/index to everything below in docs/.
items.duplicatedIn: CLAUDE.md (project) names docs/README.md as the entry point to the doc map

items.claim: Routing map (the doc's whole substance) — 'To understand X, read Y': (1) The why, the what, and the full requirements ledger → product.md; (2) Where the build stands — the four acts and the per-unit status table → roadmap.md; (3) How the engine works, and the invariants nobody may break → architecture.md; (4) The per-act build plans → plans/1-engine.md, plans/2-first-answer.md, plans/3-controls.md, plans/4-recommendation.md; (5) A specific capability's plan → plans/features/social-security.md, plans/features/other-income.md, plans/features/portfolio-holdings.md; (6) The reasoning behind the hard engineering calls → decisions/; (7) The verified reference numbers (Trinity/Bengen, tax, ACA/IRMAA) → research/engine-validation-and-tax.md, research/pre65-healthcare.md; (8) Any unfamiliar term (CRN, reduce-to-spine, MAGI, the fuck-off date) → glossary.md; (9) Hard-won gotchas + lessons (wired to /brief and /distill) → insights/.
items.duplicatedIn: CLAUDE.md 'The map (where truth lives)' section lists the same doc set and precedence

items.claim: The documentation is deliberately split by KIND into named homes, each with a single job: product.md = why + what + requirements ledger; roadmap.md = build status (four acts + per-unit status table); architecture.md = how-the-engine-works + the invariants nobody may break; plans/ = per-act build plans (4 acts) plus plans/features/ for specific-capability plans; decisions/ = reasoning behind hard engineering calls; research/ = verified reference numbers; glossary.md = term definitions; insights/ = hard-won gotchas + lessons.

The four per-act build plan files are named by their product role, not by number alone: 1-engine, 2-first-answer, 3-controls, 4-recommendation — i.e. Act 1 = the engine, Act 2 = the first answer, Act 3 = the (tax) controls, Act 4 = the recommendation. This is the 'four acts' structure referenced throughout.
The three named feature plans under plans/features/ are: social-security.md, other-income.md, portfolio-holdings.md. These are 'a specific capability's plan' (distinct from the four per-act plans).
items.fossilNote: The features/ docs are the most likely fossils-by-timing per the rewrite brief; this index lists them as a separate row only because they are capability plans added alongside the act plans.

items.claim: The two named research files holding the verified reference numbers are: research/engine-validation-and-tax.md (Trinity/Bengen + tax) and research/pre65-healthcare.md (ACA/IRMAA / pre-65 healthcare).

The insights/ folder is wired to the /brief and /distill skills — hard-won gotchas + lessons are surfaced via /brief before work and captured via /distill. (Load-bearing operational link between the docs and the skill tooling.)
